evidence.name: Screen field: Legacy fade-in
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Legacy fade-in" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Legacy fade-in
sections.description: Shows under Legacy on screens that had it switched on when you opened the editor and have no Screen Entrance set. That includes older screens, and screens whose entrance came from a theme's motion scheme once you switch Screen Entrance off. While on, the screen plays a simple fade-in as it appears; turn on Screen Entrance above to replace it with the style, speed, and stagger you choose. Switched off, the screen follows your theme's entrance, or appears without one if the theme has none.
